checkpointRule: Return every five completed families, or every two hours, whichever comes first. This lane carries one family, so it checkpoints once.

checkpoints.note: CR-289 built to the builder contract: one official form, one page, primary_filing. Canonical and boundary fixtures rendered and rastered, every visible write read back from the finalized bytes, all nine counters zero by the builder's own count. A factual claim about pre-printed X marks was found wrong on visual review and corrected in the builder and in this lane's row. Not verified here.

timestampBasis: The checkpoint time is the modification time of the family's build-status.json on the build host, which is when the build that produced it finished.
